How Zepto Makes Money 💰

Groceries in 10 minutes. But Zepto lost 3,367 crore rupees in one year. The trick is the dark store. A small warehouse near your home, with riders already waiting. It earns commission from brands, ads inside the app, and small fees on your order. Sales hit 9,668 crore rupees in FY25, more than double. But losses grew even faster. The bet: grow huge first, and make profit at scale later. Speed sells. Scale costs. Profit waits.

How Irctc Makes Money 💰

You book train tickets on it. IRCTC made 1,315 crore rupees profit in FY25. It runs four money machines. One. A small convenience fee on online tickets, multiplied by millions of bookings. Two and three. Food on trains, and Rail Neer bottled water. Four. Tourism, from tour packages to special trains. Total revenue in FY25 was 4,675 crore rupees. And it is the official ticketing arm of Indian Railways. Own the gate. Charge a little. On every trip.

Who Pays For Free Upi? 💰

You pay zero rupees to use UPI. So who pays? Every payment passes through apps, banks and N P C I systems. Running them costs real money. But under zero MDR rules, most shops pay no fee on UPI. How Jio Made Cheap Data Pay 💰

Jio once gave data almost free. Now it makes 7,022 crore rupees profit in a single quarter. The playbook. Step one: cheap data to win crores of users. Step two: make it a daily habit. Step three: raise prices slowly. By early 2025, each user paid about 206 rupees a month on average. Small price hikes, times crores of users. Now 5G, home broadband and enterprise services add more. Win users. Build habits. Then price.
